Factory-built chimneys for medium-heat appliances producing flue gases having a temperature above 1,000°F (537.8°C), measured at the entrance to the chimney, shall be listed and labeled in accordance with UL 959 and shall be installed and terminated in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and this code.
